name: Employment context and hiring acceptance evals M

machineCriteria.name: Current official opportunity context
machineCriteria.criterion: Each Tier 1 record has one official employer URL, verification and reverification dates, status, compensation, location, work model, reporting-line certainty, hard screens, and explicit confirmed, inferred, and unknown facts.

machineCriteria.name: Requirement-level role coverage
machineCriteria.criterion: Every critical requirement has a stable ID, source posture, Wiki evidence, public evidence, controlled coverage status, gap type, and next action.

machineCriteria.name: Public-only hiring evaluation
machineCriteria.criterion: The hiring evaluator reads only explicitly mapped public route sources and cannot read docs/knowledge-bank or private source material.

machineCriteria.name: Separate Wiki gap resolution
machineCriteria.criterion: A second step may use the opportunity's governed role coverage only after public evaluation and classifies projection, source, corroboration, rights, experience, hard-screen, and unknown gaps.

machineCriteria.name: Reader context without impersonation
machineCriteria.criterion: Named profiles cite public context and state that the lens is a simulation, not the person's actual opinion, participation, or endorsement.

machineCriteria.name: Configurable and candidate-bound suites
machineCriteria.criterion: Opportunity, route, reader, rubric, and candidate hashes are reported; development and holdout reader arrays are separate.

machineCriteria.name: Opportunity discovery
machineCriteria.criterion: Title-blind benchmark queries recover relevant roles, negative controls do not produce false confidence, hard screens are surfaced, and stale roles cannot present as current.

machineCriteria.name: Career and source coverage
machineCriteria.criterion: Public-safe coverage records report career phases, evidence strength, source-channel state, known gaps, and publication boundaries without exposing private locators.

machineCriteria.name: Bounded ACLU hill climb
machineCriteria.criterion: A retrospective CallNYC brief exists in the Wiki, public CallNYC copy makes discovery and bounded product judgment legible, and retrospective authorship remains explicit.

machineCriteria.name: Human and external authority
machineCriteria.criterion: Machine checks do not claim a real recruiter response, named person's opinion, collaborator approval, application acceptance, interview outcome, or production approval.
